title: Testing Auxin-Mediated Degradation of AID-Tagged Protein
author: Kizhakke Mattada Sathyan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdyfi7tn

steps.title: Prepare 50 mM auxin stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve auxin in water to 50 mM, aliquot, store at –20 °C; use a fresh aliquot each time and avoid refreezing.

steps.title: Seed AID‑tagged cells
steps.instruction: Plate ~7–8 × 10⁵ HEK293T AID‑tagged cells per well of a 6‑well plate to reach ~75 % confluence the next day.

steps.title: Add auxin to culture
steps.instruction: Add auxin dropwise to each well to a final concentration of 500 µM, then gently move the plate forward, backward and sideways to mix; do not swirl.

steps.title: Harvest cells at time points
steps.instruction: At 0 (no auxin), 15 min, 30 min, 1 h, 2 h, 3 h, and 4 h after auxin addition, remove 1 mL media from each well, resuspend cells by pipetting up‑and‑down in the remaining media, and keep the suspension on ice.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspensions
steps.instruction: Immediately centrifuge each well’s suspension in a fixed‑angle tabletop rotor at 6000 × g, 4 °C for 2 min; carefully aspirate supernatant with a pipette while keeping the pellet on ice.

steps.title: Lyse cell pellets in SDS buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 2× SDS sample buffer directly to each pellet, pipette up‑and‑down several times until viscous; alternatively, add buffer to the well after PBS wash and collect lysate with a pipette.

steps.title: Heat‑denature lysates
steps.instruction: Incubate lysates at 95 °C for 5 min, vortex 20 s, then heat again at 95 °C for another 5 min; thereafter store lysates at –20 °C.

steps.title: Assess protein degradation by Western
steps.instruction: Serially dilute the untreated lysate to place bands within the linear range, load diluted untreated and treated lysates onto SDS‑PAGE, perform Western blot using antibodies against the AID‑tagged protein, and quantify band intensities. Plot intensity versus time, fit to a one‑phase decay equation to determine degradation rate.
